Field Descriptions

core_resets_done

Logic low while performing core reset, logic high otherwise.

post_reset_count

Core reset pulse count post-reset. The duration of the pulse is the set value + 1.

pre_reset_count

Core reset pulse count pre-reset. The duration of the pulse is the set value + 1.
